acceptance: Reproduce on current develop without cloud spend (DuckDB or a mocked adapter): with an existing database, `--force datagen` must reach the adapter as `force_recreate=True` (`PlatformAdapter.force_recreate`).
If it already works: add a regression test pinning the propagation and close the item.

If it does not: fix the propagation so the adapter config carries `force_recreate` at top level, add tests for `--force datagen` and `--platform-option force_recreate=true`, and add a CHANGELOG entry.
context: Reported in ~/.benchbox/handoffs/2026-10-15-snowflake-trial-exit-handoff.md. Relevant code: benchbox/cli/commands/run.py `_force_recreate_requested` (~539) and its uses (~1326, ~1492, ~1805); benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py:128; benchbox/platforms/base/connection_lifecycle.py:182.
description: During the 2026-10-15 Snowflake campaign, `--force datagen` regenerated data but the `force_recreate` setting stayed nested in `options`, so the adapter never saw it and reused the existing database. PR #3013 later accepted `force_recreate` as a platform option, and `benchbox/cli/commands/run.py:539` now ORs `--force` regeneration into `force_recreate`, so this may already be fixed.
